result.markdown:
# Call setup failures and dropped calls in Grand Tunis

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `S-TUN-005`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct evidence of configuration changes executed one minute after the KPI degradation onset on the affected sites, supported by anomalies, matching runbook signatures, and the absence of concurrent maintenance or transport failures. External events were NOT CHECKED.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-10 10:00 to 2026-09-10 19:27
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-10 10:01
- **Affected:** S-TUN-005, S-TUN-012, S-TUN-013

## Summary

Parameter optimisation batch RT-2.4 applied via configuration push changes simultaneously caused degradation across sites S-TUN-005, S-TUN-012, and S-TUN-013.

Call setup failures and dropped calls rose across S-TUN-005, S-TUN-012, and S-TUN-013 starting at 2026-09-10 10:00, with alarms clearing and configurations rolled back later in the evening.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-10 10:00: Anomalous drop in RRC success rate and spike in drop rate started across sites S-TUN-005, S-TUN-012, and S-TUN-013. [T1, T6, ALR-0010]
- 2026-09-10 10:01: Config push changes for parameter optimisation batch RT-2.4 were executed on sites S-TUN-005, S-TUN-012, and S-TUN-013. [T3, CHG-2026-0021, CHG-2026-0022, CHG-2026-0023]
- 2026-09-10 10:42: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-TUN-012. [T2, ALM-000190]
- 2026-09-10 19:27: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm cleared after configuration rollback. [T2, ALM-000190]

## Evidence

- KPI degradation including RRC success rate drops and drop rate spikes occurred simultaneously on S-TUN-005, S-TUN-012, and S-TUN-013 starting at 2026-09-10 10:00. [T1, T6, ALR-0010, ANM-000155, ANM-000154]
- Parameter optimisation batch RT-2.4 config push changes were executed on S-TUN-005, S-TUN-012, and S-TUN-013 at 2026-09-10 10:01 and later rolled back. [T3, CHG-2026-0021, CHG-2026-0022, CHG-2026-0023]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected sites or their ancestors during the incident window. [T4]
- Only minor alarms related to RRC failure rates were triggered, with no major transport or power failures. [T2, ALM-000190]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at S-TUN-005: confirmed. Configuration changes pushing parameter optimisation batch RT-2.4 were executed immediately after the KPI degradation onset on the affected sites, matching the bad change runbook signature. [T3, CHG-2026-0021, CHG-2026-0022, CHG-2026-0023, RB-BAD-CHANGE#02, RB-BAD-CHANGE#05]
2. **transport_failure**: rejected. No transport alarms or link degradations were found in the scope during the incident window. [T2]
3. **planned_maintenance**: rejected. No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected sites or their parents. [T4]

## Ruled out

- T4: Maintenance calendar showed no scheduled maintenance windows on the affected sites and their parents.
- T2: Transport alarms and power issues were ruled out as alarms were limited to minor RRC failure rate indicators on the affected nodes.

## Recommended actions

- Review parameter optimisation batch RT-2.4 configurations before future deployments to prevent regression.
- Verify pre-change validation steps for radio parameter pushes.

truth.notes: trap=bad_change_loud_coincidence; A scheduled parameter optimisation batch pushed to the 3 sites of LNK-TUN-01-C regressed RRC success and drop rate until it was rolled back. Root cause node is the first site of the pushed group. Trap: a major alarm on LNK-TUN-01-C, the parent of the pushed sites, flaps around the onset and clears by itself, and the change record looks innocent. Settled by: (1) the alarm clears within minutes while the KPI regression goes on for hours, and availability stays at 100 %; (2) the regression starts at the change time on exactly the pushed sites and ends at the rollback; (3) the sites of the sibling links are normal.
